'''Indigo One''' was an [[Arrow-23 landspeeder/Legends|Arrow-23 landspeeder]] assigned to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Indigo Speeder Squad]]. It was deployed during the [[Raid on Saarn|raid]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saarn]].
